name: Jeff Lake Day Camp
description_short: Private day camp on 50 acre Jefferson Lake for Pre-K through 10th grade, with daily swim instruction, boating, fishing, sports, pottery and other arts, a zip line and adventure activities, plus a CIT program. Campers come by camp bus from towns across northern New Jersey.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel before February 1, 2027 for a refund less a $250 administrative fee; February 1 to April 1 the fee is $500; after April 1 deposits are not refundable.
notes: Session prices are for K to 10th grade. Pre-K pays $9,150 full season and $6,900 a half; any six weeks costs $9,150 (K to 10) or $8,750 (Pre-K). CIT (rising 10th grade) pays $7,100 full season, $5,200 a half, $6,700 for six weeks. Each application needs a $995 deposit. A 3% fee applies to credit card payments. The camp is on Waterloo Road about three quarters of a mile from Route 206; its summer mailing address is PO Box 426, Stanhope.
